referenceSql: CREATE VIEW stuview5 AS WITH means AS(SELECT s.Sno,s.Sname,s.Classno,SUM(x.Grade*c.Credit)/SUM(c.Credit) AS avg_grade FROM student s JOIN sc x USING(Sno) JOIN course c USING(Cno) WHERE x.Grade IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sc bad WHERE bad.Sno=s.Sno AND bad.Grade<60) GROUP BY s.Sno,s.Sname,s.Classno), ranked AS(SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY Classno ORDER BY avg_grade DESC) AS pos FROM means) SELECT Sno,Sname,Classno,ROUND(avg_grade,2) AS avg_grade,pos FROM ranked WHERE pos<=3;
